name: TengenX AI
name_zh: 深圳天元兴科技有限公司
summary:
TengenX AI (Tianyuanxing Technology) is a leading Chinese industrial embodied intelligence robotics company, independently spun out by the core team of SenseTime's industrial robotics division. It develops its own end-to-end closed-loop control architecture and TengenX embodied foundation models, aiming to move industrial robots from passive instruction execution to autonomous, intelligent end-to-end control.

Its core product, the TX01 wheeled humanoid dual-arm robot, combines VLA and world models for perception, planning, prediction and control. Validation of large-scale deployments has begun at leading companies in lithium batteries, new energy and related sectors. Its proprietary integrated control architecture aims to overcome key bottlenecks in flexible manufacturing and advance industrial robots into a new stage of end-to-end intelligent control.
